content:
We need propose a 3-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: steps forward are: 1) amide formation (carboxylic acid to amide). 2) Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid). 3) sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). So retrosynthetic steps should be reverse: break amide bond to give carboxylic acid and amine; break α,β-unsaturated acid to give aldehyde and malonic acid (or maybe break double bond to give aldehyde and malonic acid). And break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride and amine.

Thus we need to propose precursors: final target has sulfonamide linking a tolyl sulfonyl group to a phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl ring (para-methyl phenyl). So retrosynthesis: disconnect sulfonamide to give tolyl sulfonyl chloride (p-toluenesulfonyl chloride) and the aniline (the other aromatic ring with the unsaturated amide). Actually the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl sulfonyl group and to the aromatic ring (c2...). Wait structure: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)N c3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. So the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl ring (the first phenyl with methyl) and to the sulfonyl group which is attached to second phenyl (c2...). So the sulfonamide is between the tolyl amine (p-toluidine) and the sulfonyl chloride derived from the second phenyl sulfonyl chloride (p-? Actually the sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl). So disconnection: break S-N bond to give p-toluidine (or its protected form) and the sulfonyl chloride of the second phenyl (aryl sulfonyl chloride). That matches sulfonamide formation.

Next, the second phenyl has a side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N c3ccccc3N (an α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline). The amide is formed from carboxylic acid (the α,β-unsaturated acid) and an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So break amide to give α,β-unsaturated acid (c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2) and aniline (aniline). The α,β-unsaturated acid can be made via Doebner modification from aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid. So break double bond to give aldehyde and malonic acid.

Thus three steps: 1) sulfonamide formation (p-toluidine + aryl sulfonyl chloride). 2) amide coupling (α,β-unsaturated acid + aniline). 3) Doebner modification (aryl aldehyde + malonic acid). That's three steps.

Now we need to produce JSON route with nested reactions. The format: root node is target molecule, children are reaction nodes, each reaction node has template_id and children are precursor molecules (type mol). We need template IDs for each step. We can search for templates matching these transformations.

First, sulfonamide formation: search for templates where sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide. Use functional_groups_formed: sulfonamides.
